Title: LiteLLM: internal_user_viewer arbitrary local file read via `vertex_ai_credentials`
Description: An authenticated LiteLLM proxy user could read arbitrary local files from the proxy runtime by sending a crafted `vertex_ai_credentials` value to `/utils/transform_request`. The request-body safety blocklist rejected `vertex_credentials` but missed its alias `vertex_ai_credentials`, which let the value reach the Vertex AI credential loader and trigger a file read that is sent to an attacker-controlled URL.
